paper_title: A Search for Invisible Axion Dark Matter with the Axion Dark Matter Experiment
notes: ADMX haloscope excluding DFSZ axion-photon coupling over 2.66-2.81 ueV (645-680 MHz). Exclusion reaches DFSZ level g_agamma ~ a few x10^-16 GeV^-1; KSVZ ~2.7x larger. Density 0.45 GeV/cm^3 (isothermal halo, Maxwellian) or 0.63 GeV/cc (N-body). Data points are approximate readings from Fig.4 in units near DFSZ (~6-8 x10^-16 GeV^-1 scale on plot, y-axis in 10^-16 GeV^-1). Numerical values approximate since only a plot is provided.
